reasons.text: Coventry were beaten 3-0 with Havertz, Saka and Odegaard scoring, and Aston Villa lost 1-0 at home without registering a single shot on target, which meant Raya made no saves.
David Raya at Arsenal Arsenal’s goalkeeper department is split between one of the best shot-stoppers in the world and a collection of goalkeepers known for making absolute howlers.

Of course, it is hard to attract top-level keepers to sit on the bench, especially behind someone as consistent as Raya, but one injury to the Spaniard and the best defence in the league feels a lot more vulnerable.
The Cherries goalkeeper is one of only four players represented on the six-save shortlist, alongside Hull City’s Konstantinos Tzolakis, Everton’s Jordan Pickford and Liverpool’s Alisson Becker.

reasons.text: Coventry were beaten 3-0 with Havertz, Saka and Odegaard scoring, and Aston Villa lost 1-0 at home without registering a single shot on target, which meant Raya made no saves.
David Raya at Arsenal Arsenal’s goalkeeper department is split between one of the best shot-stoppers in the world and a collection of goalkeepers known for making absolute howlers.

Of course, it is hard to attract top-level keepers to sit on the bench, especially behind someone as consistent as Raya, but one injury to the Spaniard and the best defence in the league feels a lot more vulnerable.

Following the departures of Stefan Ortega and Angus Gunn at the end of last season, the goalkeeping department was bolstered by the arrival of former Fulham shot-stopper Steven Benda , providing competition for Matz Sels and John Victor between the sticks.
